Settings.description: Stripe settings. A member the step carries replaces the stored one.

IsLive.description: Whether the live Stripe keys are used. When false, the test keys are used.

CheckoutMode.description: The Stripe checkout integration mode. Kept for compatibility; the checkout always collects card details on the site with Payment Elements.

LivePublishableKey.description: The live publishable key. It must start with 'pk_live_', or the step fails and nothing is stored.

LivePrivateSecret.description: The live secret key. It must start with 'sk_live_', or the step fails and nothing is stored. Secret: supply it in clear text and it is data-protected before it is stored. It is never exported, and when it is omitted or empty the destination keeps the value it already stores.

LiveWebhookSecret.description: The live webhook signing secret. It must start with 'whsec_', or the step fails and nothing is stored. Secret: supply it in clear text and it is data-protected before it is stored. It is never exported, and when it is omitted or empty the destination keeps the value it already stores.

Secret: supply it in clear text and it is data-protected before it is stored. It is never exported, and when it is omitted or empty the destination keeps the value it already stores.
